part: 4-20 mA transmitter (worked example: cup anemometer 0-30 m/s)
interface: 4-20 mA current loop into burden resistor, 12 V loop supply from SIM boost converter

loop_ma_below.meaning: broken loop or dead transmitter, never a reading

failure_modes: loop_ma < 3.8: wiring fault (live zero violated); do not log the mapped value
value frozen while weather changes: seized cups or stalled transmitter
mapped value pinned at range top: over-range or shorted loop
mounting: anemometer upright, rigid mount, no obstructions to cup rotation; strain-relieve the cable
